messages:
taylor: thinking about a new 'QueryBoard' for console analytics — a shared canvas of saved views/filters across routes and models. How should ownership, default pins, and per-route visibility work? Need to decide API shape + telemetry tags. cc @maria @ken

maria: +1 on a shared canvas. two quick constraints: (1) admins need view-level auditing, (2) teams want per-route defaults that don't clutter global list. Maybe scoping levels: personal / team / org / global.

ken: agree. for permissions we should reuse existing saved-query RBAC. we already have route-level ACLs. question: should model-scoped views be a separate entity or just a filter tag?

alex: probably separate meta field `scope: {type: 'route'|'model'|'global', id: '...'} ` so UI can show context-aware suggestions. API example: ```POST /api/v1/queryboard { "name":"Errors by model", "filters":[{"field":"status","op":"=","value":"5xx"}], "scope":{"type":"route","id":"route_123"}, "visibility":"team" }```

jess: small UX ask: when someone pins a board as default for a route, we need soft ownership so they can unpin without deleting. Also show who pinned and when. :wave:

devon: telemetry: include tags for saved_view_id, scope_type, pinned=true/false. Also add a cost_estimate snapshot for views that include cost filters — that'll help Optimize team run rollout analyses. Suggest names: `saved_view.id`, `saved_view.scope`, `saved_view.pinned`

sre-bot: deploybot: New saved-views schema migration queued on prod-migrations at 03:00 UTC. No downtime expected. :robot_face:

maria: On rollback story — if a saved view references a model version that's gone, UI should show fallback to compatible model variants and mark as 'stale' with a banner and quick replace button.

ken: question for API folks: do we need an explicit 'clone' endpoint for cross-team sharing to avoid accidental ownership change? I think yes — cloning should copy filters, annotations, and pin state but reset ownership to the requester.

alex: +1. API shape idea: ```POST /api/v1/queryboard/:id/clone { "to_team": "infra" }``` returns `{ "new_id": "...", "status": "ok" }` and preserves original as read-only reference.

taylor: next steps: draft API spec, list migration risk, and a small mock in Figma. I'll add a short RFC. If you have blockers pls drop them here by EOD. :thumbsup:

jess: tiny nit — in the console list view, sort by `last_used` by default for team-scoped boards, not name. teams mostly look for recent stuff.

devon: also: add a telemetry event for `saved_view.apply` with boolean `from_pin` so we can measure pin effectiveness.

maria: I'll add audit fields: created_by, created_at, last_modified_by, last_modified_at, and a change_history pointer (read-only). That should cover compliance asks.

ken: ok — I'll scope RBAC changes and check any existing policy conflicts. if everyone is happy i'll start a PR for the API contract this week.

taylor: thanks all — will file RFC + ticket and tag design/optimize. good convo.
